title: DOES RESISTANCE TO STYLE-TRANSFER EQUAL GLOBAL SHAPE BIAS? MEASURING NETWORK SENSITIVITY TO GLOBAL SHAPE CONFIGURATION
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating global shape bias and texture bias in deep learning models for object recognition. It introduces a new testbench (DiST) and training method (DiSTinguish) to measure network sensitivity to global shape configuration. There is no component in the paper that evaluates or benchmarks religion, morals, or ethics.
